cbo_household_income_2021.title: The Distribution of Household Income in 2021 (September 2024): Appendix A, data and methods, and Appendix D, terms

note.en: The methods the 2023 report refers to. Individual income taxes and the employee's share of payroll taxes fall on the households that pay them, the employer's share of payroll taxes on the employees; excise taxes by households' consumption of the taxed goods, those on intermediate goods by overall consumption; 75% of corporate income taxes to owners of capital, 25% to workers (p. 27). Households are ranked by income divided by the square root of household size (p. 28). Payroll taxes are those of Social Security, Medicare and unemployment insurance, without the states' unemployment taxes (p. 38); the states' deposits for unemployment insurance, estate and gift taxes, Federal Reserve earnings, customs duties and fees are not allocated (p. 21, note 9). Die Haushalte werden nach dem Einkommen geteilt durch die Wurzel der Haushaltsgröße geordnet (S. 28).
